summary: Backend testing for admin strip-verified endpoint completed. 13/13 tests passed. New PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/strip-verified endpoint verified working correctly: returns 401 without auth, 403 for non-admin, 404 for non-existent user, proper message for user with no verified visits. All regression tests passed for existing endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/strip-verified endpoint correctly implemented with proper auth checks
Admin endpoint uses get_admin_user dependency which properly validates user.role == 'admin'
Returns 401 without auth token, 403 for non-admin users, 404 for non-existent users
Returns appropriate message when user has no verified visits (visits_stripped: 0)
Admin action is logged to admin_logs collection for audit trail

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin strip-verified endpoint verified. Both test users (test@wandermark.app and test2@wandermark.app) have no verified visits in dev DB, so the endpoint returns 'User has no verified visits' message.
